question: Which of the following types of additives are blended with the lubricant to reduce the surface tension of the oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __Emulsifiers.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Emulsifiers__ are additives used to reduce the surface tension of the oil.
 
• These additives help in mixing oil with water or other incompatible substances.
 
• Emulsifiers create a stable emulsion, which is crucial for certain industrial applications.
 
• They also enhance the overall lubrication performance in specific environments.
 
• Commonly used in metalworking fluids, cutting oils, and some engine oils.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Demulsifiers:**

 
 
• These additives work oppositely by breaking emulsions.
 
• They are used to separate water from oil in various industries.
 
 
 
• **Tackiness Agents:**
 
 
• These additives increase the stickiness of the lubricant, ensuring it adheres to surfaces better.
 
• They are commonly used in chain oils and greases.
 
 
 
• **Mist Suppressors:**
 
 
• These additives reduce the formation of oil mist during high-speed operations.
 
• They help improve workplace safety and reduce oil consumption.
